100 Would You Rather questions

Would You Rather needs no setup at all: read two options, everyone picks one, and then the debating starts. These 100 questions are silly, clean and surprisingly hard to answer.

How to play

  1. Read out both options.
  2. Everyone picks one at the same time: point left or right, or shout it out.
  3. The smallest side has to defend their choice.
  4. Pass to the next reader.
